facts.text: The imperial sovereign wants to respect democratic processes and local autonomy as much as possible.
The imperial sovereign wants the option of exercising absolute power as a right.
The imperial sovereign must have temperment, maturity, and wisdom.
The Empress's counselors may have to comfort her after she makes a heavy decision to overrule something and exercise absolute power in an emergency.
The Empress relies on the democratic processes of the imperial senate and local and regional governments.
The Empress exercises absolute power only when it is deemed strictly necessary.
The Empress wants to visit the forest moon.
The Empress wants to meet a protosapient face to face.
Donations and grants came pouring in after the Empress visited.

events.text: The Empress visited, after which donations and grants came pouring in.
